title: Hearty Egyptian Couscous Pilaf
description: A rich and flavorful Egyptian-inspired dish that is perfect for a sick day.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the ground beef and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until it is fully browned.
Add the chopped apricots, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Add the chickpeas and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low and let cook for 10-15 minutes.
While the mixture is cooking, bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Add the couscous to the pot and cook for 8-10 minutes, or until it is tender and fluffy.
Fluff the cooked couscous with a fork and stir in the chopped parsley.
To serve, place a scoop of the couscous mixture onto a plate, then top with the cooked couscous.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
